verdict.rationale: SigNoz ships a first-party self-hosted edition you deploy on your own Docker, Kubernetes or Linux infrastructure, which lets you decide where telemetry data physically lives. That is direct but indirect residency control. The SigNoz Cloud evidence never mentions choosing a hosting region or offering residency guarantees. missing for 10: documented region selection for SigNoz Cloud (e.g. US/EU/IN), explicit data-residency or compliance documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Free open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure. Deploy with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux and keep full control of your data plane.
